cases.title: A downpipe copied with CR gets its own next tag DP2 and its own label; with the label layer locked a second copy gets DP3, no label, and one line naming the layer
cases.plan_item: C-79b1 area test plan item 3 (#1891, BUG-1246)
cases.expected: DP at 150000,-80000 shows 'Downpipe placed. Tag: DP' and adds one downpipe block and one GUIDELINES text. CR of that downpipe to 156000,-80000 at 90 shows '[CE] The copied downpipe was given its own tag DP2 (the original stays DP1). Check where it connects.' and adds one downpipe block and one GUIDELINES text (the copy's own label). With GUIDELINES locked, a second CR to 150000,-75000 shows the same line for DP3 and '[CE] The label for DP3 was not drawn because layer GUIDELINES is locked. CE has not changed the layer; unlock it and the label can be added.', adds one downpipe block and no GUIDELINES text. The BUG-1137 line 'could not be given its own link' never appears. No CE window is left open; the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The retag only runs when a live AutoCAD copy cannot be completed in full; only a real CR on a real downpipe shows the tag, the new label object and the locked-layer refusal.
not_automated: SEEN by Codex: where the copy's own label sits beside the copy and that it reads as DP2 in the drawing's numbering mode (in DRV1_B1 a label reads 'DP' with no number, BUG-1242); the Inspector or schedule showing DP2 and DP3 once each.

The tag stored on the copied block is not read (no robot read of a CE tag); the tag is proved by CE's own command-line line only. That GUIDELINES is still locked at the end is not read. COPY, ROTATE Copy, SCALE Copy and grip copy are not driven (CR only). U is not driven.
